reported_token_usage.scope: Full uninterrupted returned stream; not an account balance or causal efficiency estimate.

risk_semantic_review.scope: All 32 first Energy/main records read semantically, with returned handbook/choices and feedback context. Core-directional completion is separated from full grounding, not inferred from labels.
risk_semantic_review.target_reason: Core explicit/recent-risk comparison is 6/8 = 75%, or 6/10 = 60% including uneasy-cue cases, below 80%. Target failure is independent of amounts supplied by current metadata.
risk_semantic_review.positive_execution: The Month24 main comparison acknowledged that Energy mitigation was only an attempt, named the current risk-reducing main choice, compared it with growth and selected it. Other notes sometimes retained uncertainty after reassuring feedback. No mitigation quota is inferred.
remaining_limitations: The first main note inferred clearance immediately after an attempt.
Uneasy feedback was sometimes treated as irrelevant unless it named a concrete risk.
Repeated current-value rankings treat unrelated raw statistics as a common scale.
Health cutoffs in later feedback conditions are participant heuristics, not published safety thresholds; no such bands are introduced into the submission policy.
At Month48 the notes correctly justify ending benefits rather than a later review; no action follows terminal observation.
Any visibility-point shorthand is not a separately published game statistic; ground it in the offered Dignity/Network changes rather than a new review formula.
risk_semantic_review.interpretation: Meaningful visibility/directional improvements are observed, but the predeclared full semantic adherence target is not met. No winner or fully compliant policy is claimed from one score.
risk_semantic_review.action_metadata_correction: Current official choices provide status_updates amounts. Matching predictions are current evidence, not invented merely because the handbook lists directions. They do not prove observed gains or clearance.

monthly_semantic_review.rubric: Same conservative checkpoint-component rubric as risk-01: prior focus in context, actual changed/persistent feedback, verified directional trend or concrete returned narrative outcome (or a specific unavailable-history gap), and current focus. Raw current-value lists alone are partial. Component completion does not validate causal or risk reasoning.
monthly_semantic_review.later_note_repetition: All 96 later ordinary notes were read. They repeat the month/progress/current-focus preamble, often as a raw value list, and some repeat substantive checkpoints. This fails the once-per-month placement rule; it is not reliable full monthly-routine adherence.
monthly_semantic_review.carry_forward: Story and primary quarterly rationales use visibility/delivery priorities and sometimes override them for Health or organisational risk. Seq 805 does reconsider a social-first hypothesis, but it claims no promotion despite the already returned L4 promotion in Month 24. Its causal interpretation is not accepted. Risk comparison assessment is separate in manual-risk-review.json.
monthly_semantic_review.mechanical_safeguards: No missing action result, fresh-state omission or post-terminal action in this run. No checkpoint-only observe/log call was identified; counts alone do not establish every call purpose.
monthly_semantic_review.scope: Monthly wording was unchanged. Differences from the prior run are execution variability, not evidence that monthly policy was improved or that quarterly wording caused a particular outcome.

audit.action_metadata_correction: See action-metadata-audit-addendum.json. Current offered numerical updates are permitted evidence; predictions and achieved gains/clearance remain distinct.

comparison_with_first_fresh_v3.interpretation: Historical first-control comparison only. The closed campaign has two fresh controls, mean 59.04; this candidate is 7.34 higher but remains one trajectory, with no confirmation and failed adherence. No demonstrated upgrade.
